label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — java.util.Random is cryptographically weak and rememberMeKey is derived from it for session token generation (used in authentication persistence). Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — cookie value from getValue() flows directly into response.getWriter() without HTML escaping; HtmlUtils.htmlEscape() applies to param but param is never used in the response output. Both alerts represent genuine vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: java.util.Random.nextGaussian() used to generate rememberMeKey for session token
cookie value printed to response without HTML escaping
